description: NOMAGO, storitve mobilnosti in potovanj, d.o.o.: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by NOMAGO, storitve mobilnosti in potovanj, d.o.o.. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Brežice, Slovenia. Coverage: Brežice, Slovenia. The Mobility Database lists 2 GTFS schedule feeds for this provider (Brežice, Slovenia). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Feed Information, Location Types, Shapes. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge but needs registration according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
